Daryti darbą iki galo, kad jis būtų baigtas.
To do work to the end, so that it would be finished.
He did the homework.

Traukti duris, kad žmonės galėtų eiti į kambarį.
To pull the door so that people could go into the room.
She opens the window in the morning.

Stumti duris ar langą, kad kambaryje būtų šilta.
To push the door or window so that in the room it would be warm.
In the evening we close the windows.

Dėti daiktą į kito žmogaus ranką.
To put a thing into another person's hand.
Mother gives the child an apple.

Kelti daiktą nuo stalo į savo ranką.
To lift a thing from the table into your own hand.
The child takes an apple from the table.

Peiliu daryti gabalus iš duonos ar mėsos.
With a knife to make pieces from bread or meat.
Mother cuts bread with a knife.

Žirklėmis daryti kito žmogaus plaukus trumpus.
With scissors to make another person's hair short.
Mother cuts the child's hair.

Ranka siųsti kamuolį per orą.
By hand to send a ball through the air.
The boy throws the ball to a friend.

Dėti dalis kartu, kad iš jų būtų vienas daiktas.
To put parts together so that from them there would be one thing.
The teacher connects sentences into one.

Uždaryti duris, kad būtų saugu nuo vagių.
To close the door so that it would be safe from thieves.
In the evening father locks the door.

Laikas klasėje, kai vaikai skaito ir rašo.
Time in the classroom when children read and write.
During the lesson we write sentences.

Universitete profesorius kalba, o studentai klauso.
At the university a professor speaks, and the students listen.
The students go to the lecture.

Pamokos vakare, kur žmonės mokosi naujos kalbos.
Lessons in the evening where people learn a new language.
She attends English language courses.

Vaikas, kuris eina į pamokas ir rašo namų darbus.
A child who goes to lessons and writes homework.
The teacher speaks with the pupil.

Jaunas žmogus, kuris mokosi universitete.
A young person who studies at the university.
At the university study many students.

Skaičius, kurį mokytojas rašo už darbą.
A number that the teacher writes for the work.
I got a good grade in mathematics.

Mokykla, kur jauni žmonės mokosi profesijos.
A school where young people learn a profession.
She studies at the university.

Kambarys mokykloje, kur vaikai turi pamokas.
A room at school where children have lessons.
The pupils sit in the classroom by the tables.

Vieni metai universitete – pirmas, antras ar trečias.
One year at the university — first, second or third.
She studies in the third year.

Pusė metų universitete; po jo yra egzaminai.
Half a year at the university; after it there are exams.
After the semester students rest.

Viena iš trijų mokslo metų dalių; po jos yra atostogos.
One of the three parts of the school year; after it there are holidays.
After the first trimester the children rest.

Mokytojas, kuris dirba tik su viena klase.
A teacher who works only with one class.
The pupils spoke with the class teacher.

Moteris, kuri dirba namuose su mažais vaikais.
A woman who works at home with small children.
The parents invite a nanny.

Dalykas mokykloje apie gyvūnus ir augalus.
A subject at school about animals and plants.
The biology lesson pleases me.

Dalykas mokykloje apie elektrą, šviesą ir vandenį.
A subject at school about electricity, light and water.
The physics lesson is hard.

Dalykas mokykloje apie šalis, upes ir kalnus.
A subject at school about countries, rivers and mountains.
In the geography lesson we look at a map.

Dalykas mokykloje apie senus laikus ir karus.
A subject at school about old times and wars.
Per istorijos pamoką kalbėjome apie karą.
During the history lesson we spoke about a war.

Žodžiai, kuriuos vartoja vienos šalies žmonės.
Words that people of one country use.
I learn the Lithuanian language.

Knygos ir eilėraščiai, kuriuos rašo autoriai.
Books and poems that authors write.
The literature books are interesting.

Dalykas mokykloje apie skaičius; ten daug skaičiuojame.
A subject at school about numbers; there we count a lot.
During the mathematics lesson we write exercises.

Knyga, iš kurios mokiniai mokosi pamokas.
A book from which pupils learn lessons.
The pupils read the textbook.

Knyga su tuščiais lapais, kur mokiniai rašo.
A book with empty pages where pupils write.
I write homework in the notebook.

Mažas darbas vadovėlyje, kurį reikia rašyti.
A small work in the textbook which must be written.
The pupils write exercises in the notebook.

Darbas, kurį kas nors duoda tau padaryti.
Work that somebody gives you to do.
The teacher gave a hard task.

Vienas sakinys, kuris rodo, kaip reikia daryti.
One sentence that shows how it must be done.
The teacher showed a good example.

Kalbėti taip, kad kitas žmogus suprastų.
To speak so that another person would understand.
The teacher explains a hard task.

Sakyti, kiek yra daiktų ar žmonių.
To say how many things or people there are.
The children count apples.

Rašyti ženklą ant popieriaus ar žemėlapio.
To write a sign on paper or on a map.
The teacher marks mistakes in the notebook.

Sunkus darbas metų pabaigoje mokykloje ar universitete.
Hard work at the end of the year at school or university.
Tomorrow I will take the mathematics exam.

Turėti daiktą rankose; neleisti jam kristi.
To have a thing in the hands; not to let it fall.
The child holds an apple in the hand.

Baigti egzaminą gerai ir gauti gerą pažymį.
To finish the exam well and get a good grade.
The student passed a hard exam.

Trumpas darbas klasėje su daug klausimų.
A short work in the classroom with many questions.
Today we wrote a hard test.

Laikas universitete, kai studentai laiko egzaminus.
The time at the university when students take exams.
During the exam session students sleep little.

Popierius, kurį gauni, kai baigi universitetą.
A paper that you get when you finish the university.
The sister got a diploma.

Trumpa kalbos dalis; iš jų darome sakinius.
A short part of language; from them we make sentences.
The pupil repeats a new word.

Stora knyga, kuri padeda versti iš kitos kalbos.
A thick book that helps to translate from another language.
New words I find in the dictionary.

Keli žodžiai kartu; juos rašome ir suprantame.
Several words together; we write them and understand them.
Write a sentence about summer.

Kai žodis ar ženklas rodo daiktą.
When a word or a sign shows a thing.
This sign means a bus stop.

Sakyti žodį taip, kad žmonės gerai girdėtų.
To say a word so that people would hear well.
The teacher pronounces a new word.
